_comment: Leaver / offboarding matrix v1.0 — 17 steps in strict security-priority order.
_usage: Steps MUST be executed in the order listed. Critical steps 1-3 must complete before any lower-priority actions.

steps.title: Revoke all active sessions and refresh tokens
steps.description: Immediately revoke all Microsoft Graph sessions, refresh tokens, and any OAuth2 delegated tokens. Use Revoke-MgUserSignInSession and set signInSessionsValidFromDateTime.

steps.title: Disable Azure AD / Entra ID account
steps.description: Set accountEnabled = false immediately after token revocation. Block sign-in to all M365 and federated services.

steps.title: Remove from all security groups
steps.description: Remove user membership from all Azure AD security groups, Microsoft 365 groups, and role assignments to prevent access via group membership.

steps.title: Remove all M365 licences
steps.description: Remove all assigned M365 licence SKUs from the user. This terminates access to Exchange, Teams, SharePoint and all M365 services.

steps.title: Convert mailbox to shared and set auto-reply
steps.description: Convert the user's mailbox to a shared mailbox (preserving email history). Configure an out-of-office/auto-reply directing senders to the appropriate contact. Grant the manager access.

steps.title: Transfer OneDrive data to manager
steps.description: Initiate OneDrive data transfer to the designated recipient (manager or data owner). Preserve for 30 days before deletion per data retention policy.

steps.title: Remove MFA methods and authentication credentials
steps.description: Delete all registered MFA authentication methods (Authenticator app, TOTP, phone, FIDO2 keys) and SSPR methods to prevent account recovery abuse.

steps.title: Remove from distribution lists
steps.description: Remove user from all Exchange Online distribution lists and mail-enabled security groups.

steps.title: Remove Teams channel memberships
steps.description: Remove user from all Microsoft Teams teams and channels. Export chat history if required by retention policy.

steps.title: Wipe and retire Intune-managed device
steps.description: Initiate remote wipe on all Intune-enrolled devices. Retire the device record. Update Autopilot if required. Confirm wipe completion before asset return.

steps.title: Remove VPN certificates and remote access
steps.description: Revoke user VPN certificates, remove user profiles from the VPN gateway, and delete any site-to-site tunnels attributed to this user.

steps.title: Revoke line-of-business application access
steps.description: Disable or delete accounts in all LOB applications (ERP, CRM, ITSM, developer tools). Reassign any workflows, approvals, or owned records to the successor.

steps.title: HR system departure recorded
steps.description: Update the HR system with the departure date, reason, and final pay details. Close the employee record.

steps.title: Asset return confirmed
steps.description: Confirm receipt of all company assets (laptop, mobile, access cards, peripherals). Update asset register with return date and condition.

steps.title: Final payroll notification issued
steps.description: Notify payroll of the final working day for accurate last-pay calculation. Include any outstanding expense claims or holiday pay.

steps.title: Audit log exported and archived
steps.description: Export the Microsoft Purview audit log for the user's activity (last 90 days minimum). Archive to secure storage per legal hold and retention requirements.

steps.title: De-provisioning sign-off recorded
steps.description: IT Manager and HR to formally sign off the completed de-provisioning checklist. File in the HR/compliance system as evidence of controlled exit.
